cultivars.description: Utricularia 'Yog-Sothoth' is an ICPS-registered cultivar of Utricularia calycifida. The cultivar authority is B.Rice. It was originated by ?, from VE, before 1990. The registration was submitted by B.Rice, Davis, USA on 22 October 1999. It was published in Carniv.Pl.Newslett.29:17 (2000). The registered etymology is: notes the potent and enigmatic entity mentioned in various stories by H.P. Lovecraft, the original Yog-Sothoth and the cultivar share features such as peculiar venation, countless sucking mouths, and an insatiable appetite. Its registration standard is Carniv.Pl.Newslett.21:10 & 12 (1992). Cultivar characteristics are defined by that registration; consult the ICPS register entry for the full description.
